acceptance_criteria_source: design_docs/planned/r2/camera-forward.md ## Acceptance criteria (AC1-AC14, each with its exact command and log line; AC14 checked at landing)

acceptance_commands.AC1: `make camera-forward-test $A && test $(grep -cE '^ok    yaw constant (forward|deck|target_stop|target_sgr_a) spread=0\.[0-9]+ deg over 16$' $S/camera-forward-test.log) -eq 4`
acceptance_commands.AC2: `grep -qE '^ok    pole in frame forward 16/16$' $S/camera-forward-test.log && grep -qE '^ok    target in frame target_stop 16/16$' $S/camera-forward-test.log && grep -qE '^ok    target in frame target_sgr_a 16/16$' $S/camera-forward-test.log`
acceptance_commands.AC3: `test $(grep -cE '^ok    (W up-screen|D right) (deck|forward|target)$' $S/camera-forward-test.log) -eq 6 && test $(grep -cE '^ok    W up-screen after switch (deck>forward|forward>target)$' $S/camera-forward-test.log) -eq 2`
acceptance_commands.AC4: `make camera-test $A && grep -qE '^ok    AC4 deck clear after fades: 0 blocked of [0-9]+ samples$' $S/camera-test.log && grep -qE '^ok    occluder group = spire, lift$' $S/camera-test.log`
acceptance_commands.AC5: `grep -qE '^ok    envelope keeps the angle$' $S/camera-forward-test.log && grep -qE '^ok    eye above deck at 48 samples$' $S/camera-forward-test.log`
acceptance_commands.AC6: `test $(grep -cE '^ok    (switch ease max [0-9.]+ deg/s|reduced cut|mapping at ease end|re-aim on aim exit|no re-aim on walk)$' $S/camera-forward-test.log) -eq 5`

acceptance_commands_note: verbatim commands (markdown escaping removed); this copy is the one to run
